name: @proworks-hub/investmentiq
description: InvestmentIQ — investment positions and policy: convention-true yield family (discount, MMY, BEY, EAY), day-count-required accrual, effective-interest amortization to par with the residual declared, six ternary limit tests where indeterminate never rounds down to compliant, disposal with a required method over a declared lot order, and cash-equivalent candidacy that never asserts.
